_doc: The network-posture sentence, authored by the backend (AgentAutonomyPolicy.DescribeNetwork) and asserted by BOTH stacks so the Launch composer's pre-launch prediction can never drift from the sentence the run's journal carries. Backend drift detector: backend/tests/CodeSpace.UnitTests/Agents/NetworkPostureWordingDriftTests.cs. Frontend drift detector: frontend/src/lib/launchInput.test.ts ('network posture wording'). Changing a word means changing this file, and both tests must go green on the new words.
_confinementDoc: confinementCases are the sentences a run gets once its launch RECORDED what the sandbox actually did (agent_run.sandbox_confinement). The composer can never produce these — it speaks before a run exists, so it has no record and always falls back to a 'cases' line. Both stacks still pin them: the backend asserts DescribeNetwork produces each line for its confinement record, and the frontend asserts each one drops the caveat the composer must keep, so a change that made the resolved sentence merely APPEND to the hedge would go red.

cases.line: Network: off (Standard) — severed only where the sandbox confines
Network: off (Confined) — severed only where the sandbox confines
Network: clamped off by policy (ceiling Standard) — severed only where the sandbox confines
Network: clamped off by policy (ceiling Standard) — severed only where the sandbox confines
Network: clamped off by policy (ceiling Confined) — severed only where the sandbox confines

confinementCases.line: Network: off (Standard) — confined, but egress was NOT severed
Network: off (Standard) — OFF REQUESTED BUT UNCONFINED: this host cannot sever egress (not-linux)
Network: off (Confined) — OFF REQUESTED BUT UNCONFINED: this host cannot sever egress (no-bwrap)
Network: clamped off by policy (ceiling Standard) — OFF REQUESTED BUT UNCONFINED: this host cannot sever egress (no-userns)
Network: clamped off by policy (ceiling Standard) — confined: egress severed
Network: off (Standard) — OFF REQUESTED BUT UNCONFINED: this runner applies no confinement
